# Ted Brine

> Software engineer from Great Britain. Runs ellipse Software, building Bast, Helios, and software for other teams.

## About

Ted Brine is a software engineer based in Great Britain. He runs ellipse Software, a studio that builds Bast (a terminal SSH host and key manager), Helios (a lighting control platform), and software for other teams. This site is his personal portfolio and primary contact point.

## Expertise

- Developer tools and terminal software
- SSH, infrastructure, and server access
- Lighting control systems
- Custom software for teams
- Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Cloudflare
